ShortDescription.Value: Segment-based road renaming, saved route designations, route shields and traffic statistics.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Advanced Road Naming
# Main Features - Rename only the selected segments of a road. - Assign route designations such as A1, M2, I-23 or Route 10 while preserving base names.
# Route Shields Display customisable route shields periodically along saved routes.
- Choose from more than 20 bundled shield designs covering Australia, New Zealand, North America, Europe, Asia and Africa. - Configure shield visibility, size and spacing. - Import your own SVG shields from the Advanced Road Naming ModsData folder. - Use the included Route Shield Designer to configure custom route text, positioning, colours and more.
Custom route shield importing and the designer are still works in progress.
# Route Statistics Saved routes can show traffic volume and traffic flow information. (Calculations only run when Statistics page is open)
# Configurability Use the settings page to configure various behaviours and if desired disable features
# Persistence and Network Changes The mod stores saved routes and segment information in your save and attempts to preserve custom names and designations when roads are upgraded, split or connected to new intersections.
The base game can rebuild its own road aggregates after some network changes. If a name or designation is displaced, use Reapply or Rebuild from the saved route manager. Name persistence continues to be improved.
# Credits
- krzychu124 - Gave insights into how the aggregate system worked, and how to persist changes. - Bruceyboy24804 - Improving Json code. - River Mochi - Providing implementation insights into settings information/tool tip colour formatting
# Compatibility
- Works with Road Name Remover - Works with City Watchdog; Road Name Hiding Functionality

ChangeLog.Value:
- Improved performance when selecting, editing, and previewing routes. - Reduced unnecessary background processing and UI updates. - Improved responsiveness when managing large numbers of saved routes. - Fixed route shields bunching together or appearing unevenly spaced. - Improved shield placement around bends, junctions, and route endpoints. - Added overlap prevention to keep shields readable at different zoom levels and UI scales. - Prevented duplicate shields while editing saved routes. - Improved route updates after roads are changed or a city is loaded. - Formatted settings option descriptions with colours
Known Issues - Renamed roads can sometimes still be overridden by road geometry changes / updates eg. using Traffic to change lanes and, adding, manipulating or removing road segments. Name persistence is still being improved.
